api_endpoints.description: Authenticates a user and returns an access token.
Retrieves the currently authenticated user's profile.
Creates a new counter for the authenticated user.
Retrieves all counters for the authenticated user.
Retrieves a specific counter by ID for the authenticated user.
Increments a specific counter's value by one.
Decrements a specific counter's value by one.
Resets a specific counter's value to zero.
Updates a specific counter's name or value.
Searches counters by name for the authenticated user.
Populates database with realistic demo data.
Returns aggregate counts and key metrics for the dashboard.

features: Allows users to create new counters with a user-defined name, initialized to zero.
Provides a mechanism to increase a counter's value by one.
Provides a mechanism to decrease a counter's value by one.
Allows users to set a specific counter's value back to zero.
Displays all counters created by the user with their current values.
Enables users to remove unwanted counters.

user_stories.want: to create a new counter with a specific name
acceptance_criteria: The user can input a name for the new counter.
Upon creation, the new counter's value is initialized to 0.
The newly created counter is visible in my list of counters.
Clicking an 'increment' button increases the counter's value by 1.
The displayed value of the counter updates immediately after incrementing.
The incremented value is persisted and remains correct upon refresh.
Clicking a 'decrement' button decreases the counter's value by 1.
The displayed value of the counter updates immediately after decrementing.
The decremented value is persisted and remains correct upon refresh.

user_stories.want: to reset a counter's value to zero
acceptance_criteria: There is a clear option to reset a specific counter.
Confirming the reset action sets the counter's value to 0.
The reset value is persisted and remains 0 upon refresh.

user_stories.want: to view all my created counters and their current values
acceptance_criteria: Upon logging in, a list of all my counters is displayed.
Each counter in the list shows its name and current numerical value.
The list is updated to reflect any changes made to individual counters.
There is a clear option to delete a specific counter.
After confirming deletion, the counter is removed from my list.
The deleted counter is no longer accessible or visible.

non_functional_requirements.authentication: required — Users need to log in to manage their personal counters.
non_functional_requirements.authorization: Users can only view, create, update, and delete their own counters.

out_of_scope: Counter history or logging of changes
Notifications or alerts based on counter values

crm.idea: A simple CRM for small businesses with user login. Users manage contacts (name, email, phone, company, status: lead/prospect/customer/churned). Add notes to any contact with timestamps. Log interactio

api_endpoints.description: Populates database with realistic demo data.
Logs in a user and returns an access token.
Retrieves the currently authenticated user's details.
Retrieves a list of contacts for the authenticated user, with optional search and pagination.
Retrieves details for a specific contact.
Creates a new contact for the authenticated user.
Adds a new note to a specific contact.
Retrieves all notes for a specific contact.
Logs a new interaction for a specific contact.
Retrieves all interactions for a specific contact.
Retrieves counts of contacts grouped by their status (Lead, Prospect, Customer, Churned).
Searches contacts by name or company name.

features: Secure user login and registration to access the CRM.
Create, view, update, and delete contacts with name, email, phone, company, and status (lead/prospect/customer/churned).
Add timestamped notes to any contact for internal context.
Log interactions (call/email/meeting) with a date and outcome for each contact.
Visualize contacts grouped by their status (Lead, Prospect, Customer, Churned) with counts for each group.
Search contacts by their name or company name.

user_stories.want: to log in securely to my CRM account
acceptance_criteria: Given I am on the login page, when I enter valid credentials and click 'Login', then I am redirected to my contacts dashboard.
Given I am on the login page, when I enter invalid credentials and click 'Login', then I see an error message 'Invalid credentials'.

user_stories.want: to add a new contact with their details
acceptance_criteria: Given I am on the contacts page, when I click 'Add Contact' and fill in name, email, phone, company, and select a status, then the new contact appears in my contact list.
Given I am adding a new contact, when I leave a required field (e.g., name) blank, then I see a validation error and the contact is not created.

user_stories.want: to add a note to a contact
acceptance_criteria: Given I am viewing a contact's details, when I enter text into the 'Add Note' field and click 'Save Note', then the note appears in the contact's notes section with a timestamp.
Given a contact has multiple notes, when I view the contact's details, then the notes are displayed in chronological order (newest first).

user_stories.want: to log an interaction (call, email, meeting) with a contact
acceptance_criteria: Given I am viewing a contact's details, when I select an interaction type (Call, Email, Meeting), a date, and an outcome, then the interaction is added to the contact's interaction log.
Given a contact has logged interactions, when I view the contact's details, then the interactions are displayed chronologically with type, date, and outcome.

user_stories.want: to see my contacts grouped by their status in a pipeline view
acceptance_criteria: Given I navigate to the 'Pipeline' view, then I see distinct sections for 'Lead', 'Prospect', 'Customer', and 'Churned' contacts.
Given I have contacts with different statuses, when I view the pipeline, then each status section displays the correct count of contacts assigned to that status.

user_stories.want: to search for contacts by name or company
acceptance_criteria: Given I am on the contacts list, when I type 'John' into the search bar, then only contacts with 'John' in their name are displayed.
Given I am on the contacts list, when I type 'Acme Corp' into the search bar, then only contacts associated with 'Acme Corp' are displayed.

non_functional_requirements.authentication: required — users need to log in to access their private contact data.
non_functional_requirements.authorization: Users can only access and manage their own contacts and associated data.
non_functional_requirements.pagination: required on contacts list if the number of contacts exceeds a reasonable display limit (e.g., 50).
